Select canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name
Join compound_structures on compound_structures.molregno = metabolism.substrate_record_id
Join molecule_dictionary as substrate on substrate.molregno = metabolism.substrate_record_id
Join molecule_dictionary as parent on parent.molregno = metabolism.metabolite_record_id
Join metabolism on metabolism.substrate_record_id = substrate.molregno
Join metabolism on metabolism.metabolite_record_id = parent.molregno
Join target_dictionary on target_dictionary.tid = metabolism.enzyme_tid
Filter target_dictionary.pref_name = 'CYP2E1'
Limit 200
